name: Matt Huffman
office: Speaker of the Ohio House of Representatives
stance: Supports child-protection AI bills but is wary of broader rules on what AI companies may do.

statements.text: Trying to say what it is a particular company can and can't do regarding artificial intelligence, it's a little bit different animal and certainly beyond the scope of simple protection of your citizens and including children
